Czechia – Pumps and compressors – 9856- Náhrada havarijních čerpadel bóru 2. HVB, systém TB1 (typ 3CHG-6K-14-2, CG-50/50K-15-1)
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je zpracování projektové dokumentace, dodávka a následná realizace díla s názvem „9856- Náhrada havarijních čerpadel bóru 2. HVB, systém TB1 (typ 3CHG-6K-14-2, CG-50/50K-15-1)“ v JE Dukovany formou vyšší kompletované dodávky souboru strojů a zařízení a provedení všech nutně vyvolaných a požadovaných úprav na dotčených zařízeních, konstrukcích a systémech. V rámci realizace JMA 9856 Dodavatel provede na zvolených pozicích náhradu havarijních podávacích čerpadel roztoku kyseliny borité 3,4TB20,40,60D01 typu 3CHG-6K-14-2 a typu CG-50/50K-15-1. Jedná se celkem o 6 ks čerpadel. Jsou požadována čerpadla v bez ucpávkovém provedení (s magnetickou spojkou) a samostatným motorem, chlazená okolním vzduchem. Součástí výměny je úprava navazujících potrubních tras sání a výtlaku, navazující potrubí recirkulace a drenáže a úprava uchycení nového čerpadla dle nově vybraného soustrojí. Zhotovitel provede úpravu podpůrných ocelových konstrukcí v rozsahu nezbytném pro instalaci nových čerpadel a úpravu stávajícího betonového základu. Dále proběhne výměna kabeláže z přechodových skříněk po pohon a zrušení samostatného uzavřeného chladícího okruhu čerpadel. Přesné vymezení Předmětu veřejné zakázky a ostatní požadavky na jeho provedení včetně informací, podmínek, specifikací a ostatních údajů jsou detailně specifikovány v části 3 a 4 Zadávací dokumentace.

title: SDA Forest Service Land Management Integrated Resources BPA (LMIR) FY26 Hebo Snag and Downed Wood Project
description: BPA Call Order Exceeding $20,000 Synopsis Requisition 1167578 The USDA Forest Service (FS). Procurement & Property Services (PPS) is issuing this special notice as a means of complying with USDA Acquisition Regulation (AGAR), SUBPART 412.201-1, requiring that all calls above $20,000 be posted to the Government Point of Entry (GPE). The USDA FS intends on awarding a competitive BPA Call Order against the LMIR BPA to secure services secure services for Timber Stand Improvement thinning, bucking, and hand pilling on 421 acres (165 acres mandatory and 256 acres optional). Only activity created fuels will be treated via hand cut and hand pile or grapple piling. Units are in plantations that were previously planted in the 1990s. 12363N23Q4023 The Land Management Integrated Resources BPA (LMIR) is a National BPA that consists of a large variety of work including Professional Services, Natural Resources Restoration, Project Management, NEPA, Communications, and more. The BPA can be utilized on all Forests and Grasslands and is available for all federal agencies to utilize. This is not a solicitation. This synopsis notification of intent to award a BPA Call order does not constitute a request for proposals or submission of any information in response to this notification. This procurement is restricted to those approved companies eligible for call orders under the Land Management Integrated Resources BPA (LMIR) for USFS. There are currently 140 businesses that will receive this solicitation. The Call Order shall be issued via email to those companies listed on the BPA. Any changes to the Call Order RFQ shall also be emailed to those companies listed on the BPA. Contracting Officer: William Ristoff william.g.ristoff@usda.gov This requirement will be competitively awarded as a BPA Call Order against the multiple award schedule BPA continuously solicited on the GPE at: SAM.gov. If contractors are not on the LMIR BPA and wish to join, they can respond to the BPA during the on boarding window which is Oct 1-Oct 31st each year for the life of the BPA. For instructions on how to join the BPA, search "Contract Opportunities" on sam.gov using solicitation number "12363N23Q4023" or emailing the LMIR BPA team for a list of on boarding instructions.

description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested, and a written solicitation is attached. Solicitation W50S9H26QA039 incorporates provisions and clauses effective through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01, dated 13 March 2026. This requirement is set aside 100% Small Business. North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS) is 336413, with a size standard of 1,250 Employees. All qualified Small Businesses under this industry are encouraged to submit quotations. Description of Requirement: AIRCRAFT LIFTING SYSTEMS FOR CRASH DAMAGE OR DISABLED AIRCRAFT RECOVERY (CDDAR) The Volk Field Air National Guard Base requires the procurement of specialized Crash Damage or Disabled Aircraft Recovery (CDDAR) equipment to maintain mission readiness and ensure safe recovery operations. The required items include: 15?Ton Pneumatic Aircraft Lifting Air Bag Stations (Part Number: 9314-010, Model 9314-010), a Control Console (Part Number: 9316-010, Control Console for Model 9314 010), and a Fuselage Lifting System capable of supporting both narrow?body and wide?body aircraft. These systems are essential for executing aircraft lifting, stabilization, and recovery tasks in accordance with Air Force CDDAR standards. The equipment supports critical operational capability for responding to aircraft incidents and enables Volk Field to meet established USAF recovery procedures, safety requirements, and interoperability expectations across Air Force CDDAR programs. See the attached SF 1449, Brand Name Justification & Approval (J&A), and Specifications document(s) for all additional details, requirements, and technical information related to this solicitation. All quotes will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation procedures described in this solicitation. ***Offers must include complete and detailed technical specifications to enable the Government's evaluation and determination of technical acceptability. Incomplete submissions or failure to provide adequate technical details may result in the offer being deemed technically unacceptable and removed from consideration. Quotes must include estimated delivery date, SAM Unique ID Number, CAGE Code, and Tax Identification number. Shipping is to be FOB Destination to Zip Code 54618. Pricing must remain valid until 30 September 2026. REFERENCES: The following publications are available electronically at https//www.acquisition.gov/ Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS: Offerors shall be required to return the attached Standard Form 1449 Solicitation W50S9H26QA039 signed and filled in appropriately as their offer along with any additional information required to be submitted by FAR 52.212-1 Instructions to Offerors Addenda and any additional fill-in provisions. All contractors MUST be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) http://www.sam.gov database at the time of submission of quotes. QUESTIONS DUE DATE AND TIME: All questions concerning this solicitation shall be sent via email to: WI.CRTC.VF.Contracting@us.af.mil by 8 September 2026 at 1:00 PM CDT. A question and answer (Q&A) will be posted, if required, approximately 2 business days after all questions have been received. OFFER DUE DATE AND TIME: Offers are due 15 September 2026 at 01:00 PM CDT. Offerors MUST provide quotes via e-mail only. LATE OFFERS: Offerors are responsible for submitting quotations, and any modifications, revisions, or withdrawals, so as to reach the Government office designated in this solicitation by the time specified in the solicitation. Quotations or modification of quotations received at the e-mail address specified for the receipt of offers after the exact time specified for receipt of offers WILL NOT be considered (ref. FAR 52.212-1(f)). title: Request for Information: Small Business Participation Goals- John Day Overhead Lifting Devices Repair
description: 1. NOTICE AND DISCLAIMER This is a Request for Information (RFI) issued solely for market intelligence and acquisition planning purposes. It does not constitute a formal Solicitation, Request for Proposal (RFP), or Request for Qualifications (RFQ), and no solicitation is currently available. Participation in this RFI is strictly voluntary. The Government will not award any agreement or contract as a result of this notice, nor will it reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparing or submitting a response. Submission of a response does not obligate the Government in any way and will not affect a firm's ability to submit a proposal should formal solicitation be issued in the future. NAICS Code: 238290 � Other Building Equipment Contractors. Small Business Size Standard at $22 million. 2. PURPOSE U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Portland District is requesting industry input on Small Business Subcontract Goals for an upcoming solicitation. 3. SCOPE OF WORK Contractor will pick-up five below-the-hook (BTH) lifting devices from the John Day powerhouse, remove and dispose of lead paint from the devices, make critical weld repairs at an off-site shop, paint the lifting devices, perform 125% load testing, and return the devices to John Day powerhouse. Devices are considered real property. Magnitude of Construction is $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. 4. GOALS Category Suggested Small Business Subcontracting Goals SB 50.0% SDB 3.0% WOSB 7.0% HUBZone Best Effort - 0.5% VOSB 22.0% SDVOSB 6.0% 5. REQUESTED FEEDBACK / RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS The Government requests industry feedback on the suggested Small Business subcontracting goals identified in this RFI. Respondents are encouraged to review the scope of work and provide input on whether the proposed goals are realistic, challenging and attainable for this requirement. If a respondent believes alternative goals would be more appropriate, the respondent is encouraged to propose recommended counter-goals and provide the supporting rationale. At a minimum, respondents are requested to address the following: a. Respondent Interest/Role Respondents are requested to identify whether they intend to pursue this requirement as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor. b. Achievability of Suggested Goals State whether the suggested subcontracting goal ranges are realistic for the work described in this RFI. c. Recommended Counter-Goals If different goals are recommended, provide proposed subcontracting goal percentages or ranges for each category below: Small Business (SB) Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) HUBZone Small Business Veteran-Owned Small Business (VOSB) Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) d. Rationale for Recommendations Explain the basis for any recommended change to the Government�s suggested goal ranges. Include, as applicable: Availability of qualified subcontractors Specialized nature of the work Safety, certification, or licensing requirements Lead paint abatement and disposal requirements Welding and fabrication capability requirements Load testing capability requirements Transportation, mobilization, or geographic constraints Typical subcontracting approach for similar repair efforts Cybersecurity compliance requirements, including Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) e. Subcontracting Feasibility by Work Element Identify which portions of the work are likely to be subcontracted and which portions are more likely to be self-performed by the prime contractor. If useful, address the following elements: Pick-up and transport Lead paint abatement/disposal Weld repairs Surface preparation and painting 125% load testing Return/delivery f. Market Constraints / Barriers Identify any factors that may limit small business participation or affect achievement of the suggested goals. g. Assumptions State any assumptions used in developing the response. Responses should be limited to information relevant to market research and acquisition planning. Proprietary information, if any, should be clearly identified and marked accordingly. This RFI is issued for market research purposes only. Responses will be used to inform the Government�s acquisition planning and development of subcontracting goals. The Government may adopt, revise, or decline to use any feedback received.

NOTICE FOR FILING AGENCY PROTESTS United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Ombudsman Program The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) is committed to fair, transparent, and efficient acquisitions. Interested parties with concerns about this solicitation are encouraged to seek resolution through the following USDA procedures. Tier 1: Contracting Officer Concern Resolution Submission: Interested parties with concerns about either the solicitation or subsequent award should first submit their concern directly to the Contracting Officer, providing sufficient detail to allow the Contracting Officer to understand and assess the issue. Process: The Contracting Officer will review the concern, seek clarification as needed, and engage with the interested party to attempt prompt resolution. Review Timeline: The Contracting Officer will make every effort to provide a response or resolution within 10 business days of receiving the concern. Effect on Award or Performance: Tier 1 engagement is not considered an official notification of filing an agency protest and does not pause solicitation deadlines, delay award decisions, or suspend contract performance. Next Steps: If the matter cannot be resolved at Tier 1, the interested party may file a written agency protest under Tier 2. USDA encourages all parties to seek resolution with the Contracting Officer before filing an agency protest. Tier 2: Agency Protest If concerns cannot be resolved at Tier 1, an interested party may file a written agency protest with either the Contracting Officer or the USDA Independent Review Authority. The decision by the USDA Independent Review Authority is an alternative to a decision by the Contracting Officer. The USDA Independent Review Authority will not consider an appeal of the Contracting Officer�s decision on an agency protest. The protest must state whether the protester elects review by the Contracting Officer, by the UDSA Independent Review Authority. If no election is stated, the Contracting Officer will decide the protest. Required Information: Protests shall include the information set forth in FAR 33.104-4 (a)(3). Failure to submit the required information may result in a delay or dismissal of the protest. Submission: Agency protests should be submitted electronically to SPE.inquiry@usda.gov and the Contracting Officer. Timeliness: Protests must be filed within the timeframes specified in FAR 33.104. Effect on Award or Performance: Contract awards or performance will be suspended during the protest period unless justified in writing for urgent and compelling reasons or determined to be in the best interest of the Government. Review Timeline: USDA strives to resolve agency-level protests within 35 business days of receipt. Election of Forum: By filing a protest with USDA, the protesters agree not to file a protest on the same matter with the Government Accountability Office (GAO) or any other external forum while the agency protest is pending. If such a protest is filed externally, the USDA agency protest will be dismissed. Questions: Questions regarding this notice or protest procedures should be directed to the Contracting Officer identified in this solicitation.

title: AFCEC Operation Support Services
description: Solicitation for Air Force Civil Engineer Center (AFCEC) Operation Support Services Tyndall AFB, FL. This is an announcement for a competitive total small business 8(a) set-aside for a service acquisition as required by the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 5. This is a Request for Proposal (RFP). Vendors shall submit proposals in response to this announcement. The purpose of this contract is to provide operation support services for AFCEC at Tyndall AFB, FL in accordance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS) in a manner that supports all phases of the civil engineer research, development, and acquisition process. The contractor shall provide management and labor support necessary to provide baseline operations support capability for AFCEC, including crosscutting operational functions; maintenance of facilities at TAFB FL and aid (e.g., produce prototypes, test articles etc. as described in PWS para 1.2) in accomplishing Research Development Test and Evaluation (RDTE), Airforce Pavement Evaluation (APE) Team and other projects and events on TAFB, FL. This includes maintaining the AFCEC Readiness Directorate, Requirements and Acquisition Division (AFCEC/CXA) test ranges and facilities (i.e., Bldg. 1117, facilities in the 9700 area, AFCEC fire research area at Silver Flag, test ranges, and other facilities managed by AFCEC at Tyndall Air Force Base (TAFB), FL; to include occupants assigned to these facilities by AFCEC and/or aiding organizations with AFCEC support agreements. All work performed by the contractor shall be performed in accordance with all applicable laws, regulations, Air Force (AF) standards and policies, instructions, and commercial practices. The duration of this contract is expected to be for a base period of twelve months plus four option years at twelve months each. The solicitation will be for a commercial service and prepared in accordance with RFO Part 12 Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. The solicitation will result in a firm, fixed price contract. The successful contractor will be selected using Best Value Trade-Off source selection procedures, resulting in the best value for the Government. The government does not intend to hold a site visit prior to the solicitation response deadline. The exact date and time will be identified in the solicitation. The solicitation will only be made available via the Governmentwide Point of Entry (GPE) via https://sam.gov. No paper copies will be issued. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring sam.gov for the release of the solicitation package. The applicable NAICS Code and Small Business Administration (SBA) Size Standard for this acquisition are 541990 and $19.5M, respectively. The applicable Product Service Code is R499. This acquisition will be a competitive total small business 8(a) set-aside. To be eligible for contract awards, offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). Registration is accomplished via the SAM website at https://www.sam.gov. Any questions related to this solicitation must be submitted in writing via email to Mr. Cleville Yarbrough at cleville.yarbrough@us.af.mil and Mr. Scott Dubuque at scott.dubuque@us.af.mil by 14 August 2026. title: H142--Intent to Sole Source VASNHS Pharmacy Hood Testing and Certification
description: The Department of Veterans Affairs, Southern Nevada VA Healthcare System, intends to award a firm-fixed-price, sole source contract to Technical Safety Services (TSS) for specialized cleanroom certification, environmental monitoring, and testing services required for multiple pharmacy and compounding areas within the medical center. TSS is the only known vendor capable of providing all required semi annual, annual, and monthly testing services in accordance with USP <797>, USP <800>, CETA standards, and VA healthcare performance requirements. These services include airflow and leak testing, particle counting, airflow visualization studies, viable air and surface sampling, room pressure and air exchange verification, laminar flow unit and isolator certification, and preparation of formal compliance documentation. The integrated nature of these services requires a vendor with established expertise, calibrated instrumentation, and the ability to perform testing without disrupting critical pharmacy operations. Based on the Government s market research and previous performance history, no other vendor has demonstrated the ability to meet all required service frequencies, technical specifications, compliance standards, and facility specific operational needs. Estimated Contract Value: Total Estimated Value: $164,396.48 CATEGORY: RESPONSE FROM INTERESTED BUSINESSES Businesses that believe they are capable of providing the required services may submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to meet all technical, regulatory, and performance requirements described in this notice. Interested businesses must provide the following information: Company Name, UEI Number, and Business Size Classification (e.g., SDVOSB, VOSB, small business, etc.). Evidence of Technical Capability, including: Demonstrated experience performing USP <797> and <800> compliant testing. Documentation showing CETA-compliant certification capabilities. Proof of calibrated instruments and ability to conduct all service categories listed in the Base and Option Year schedules. Past Performance, specifically for VA medical centers, DoD facilities, or other hospital cleanroom environments. Ability to Meet Required Frequencies and Scope, including semi annual, annual, and monthly testing. Statement of Availability, confirming your ability to perform services onsite in Southern Nevada. Any Additional Supporting Evidence demonstrating why your business can fully meet the Government s needs. Deadline for Submission: All capability statements must be submitted no later than September 15, 2026, at 12:00 PM PST. Submission Method: Email responses to the Contracting Office at[insert contracting officer s email] with the subject line: Response to Intent to Sole Source Southern Nevada VA Cleanroom Certification Services Late submissions may not be considered.

title: W912P626QA028 Salamonie Lake Garage Door Replacement
description: Notice ID: W912P626QA028Primary Solicitation Manager: Adam Haley Subject: Salamonie Lake Garage Door Replacement Description: This Pre-Solicitation Notice is being issued by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Chicago District, to inform interested contractors of the Districts intent to issue a construction solicitation for the Salamonie Lake Garage Door Replacement project located near Lagro, Wabash County, Indiana. PROJECT INFORMATION: This notice concerns a planned construction project for garage-door replacement and related facility improvements at Salamonie Lake. DESCRIPTION: The project includes framing and enclosing open bays in the Old Barn and the lean-to on the New Barn; installing a metal ceiling; installing concrete footers, drainage, floors, and landings; performing asphalt removal, regrading, and resurfacing; adding or replacing exterior man doors, garage-door fixtures, overhead garage doors, and wall-mounted openers; and installing an industrial radio remote door and gate-opening system. The improvements are intended to provide secure and reliable access, improve drainage and weather protection, protect Government equipment, and extend the service life of the facilities. CONTRACTING OFFICE: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Chicago District, 231 South LaSalle Street, Suite 1500, Chicago, IL 60604.ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The anticipated North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, with a small-business size standard of $45 million. title: Public Environmental Services at Downtown BID
description: Notice of Intent to Issue a Sole Source Contract for public environmental services around the commercial and office buildings, as well as the public spaces within the Downtown BID jurisdiction in Washington DC. Description: The General Services Administration (GSA) Public Building Service (PBS) Acquisition Center for Facilities Management Services (ACFMS) - East intends to issue a sole source contract in accordance with FAR 6.103-1. The proposed contract will include a twelve-month base period and three twelve-month option periods. The contract work will be performed at the Downtown BID jurisdiction in Washington DC. The contract will provide the following services: Cleanliness, Maintenance and Beautification Supplement municipal trash collection by bagging, hauling, and compacting trash and recycling from cans and the ground around GSA buildings for collection by the Department of Public Works. Remove graffiti and other applied vandalism from buildings, sidewalks, and fixtures within 24 hours. Clean dirt, litter, and grime from sidewalks around GSA buildings, and power clean sidewalks and public spaces on a regular basis. Remove gum and gum stains from sidewalks around GSA buildings using specialized mechanical equipment. Paint and visually improve public space elements around GSA buildings, including benches, trash receptacles, poles, lights, tree boxes, newsstands, and other designated fixtures. Plant and maintain flowers, trees, tree boxes, hanging flower baskets, and other landscaping around targeted GSA buildings. Operate a targeted rat abatement program wherever needed in the BID area. Homeless Services Engage a social services agency to provide full-time professional outreach workers to connect individuals experiencing homelessness with essential services, while helping GSA and other property owners eliminate encampments and aggressive panhandling. Coordinate efforts directly with the Department of Health (detox), Department of Mental Health (homeless outreach), Department of Employment Services, and Department of Human Services (food stamps and medical assistance) to deliver resources directly to the downtown homeless population. Focus on connecting the most entrenched population�specifically the severely mentally ill and those battling addictions�with housing recovery programs. Maintain and train a select group of Downtown Safety Ambassadors (SAM) to serve on the Homeless Outreach Service Team (HOST). Expand HOST activities to work with GSA, as well as public and private property managers, to discourage encampments and aggressive panhandling in private spaces. Coordinate outreach efforts with other Business Improvement Districts (BIDs). Develop additional strategies related to the 2nd and D Street shelter to improve the quality of life for GSA and other tenants in adjacent buildings. Expand the BID's education efforts to reach office workers, residents, and visitors. Economic Development Maintain its role as a center for research and information regarding the downtown economy Continue the collection and analysis of data, as well as the production of reports to help inform business and development decisions in the downtown area. Assist in developing financing plans and exploring possibilities for large-scale projects that support downtown infrastructure. General Support to GSA The BID�s professional staff and consultants will be facilitating collaborative planning with GSA and other major downtown stakeholders, including the city and private development community. This effort will address common concerns such as security, transportation and access, environmental issues, and development. The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1) as cited in FAR 6.302-1: �Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements�. Downtown BID is formally registered as a business improvement district in the District of Columbia and is the only firm capable of partnering with property owners in the designated area to provide a comprehensive bundle of enhanced services. These services go beyond the levels provided by other governmental or private sector sources. Currently, there is no other known public or private entity with the broad support and capacity required to simultaneously make the relevant area safe, clean, and user-friendly. The current contract is scheduled to expire on October 6, 2026. GSA will consider any bids, proposals, quotations, or capability statements. Any response shall be submitted via e-mail to Jose Nativisegovia, Contracting Officer via email at jose.nativisegovia@gsa.gov NO LATER THAN Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 4:00 PM EST. The agency will consider any such submission.

title: Notice of Intent to Award Sole Source - Cold Weather Gear
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS/QUOTES The 97th CON Squadron at Altus, OK 73523 intends to solicit and negotiate a sole-source, firm-fixed-price contract for the acquisition of cold weather gear. The 97th Contracting Squadron intends to make award this contract to AbilityOne San Antonio Lighthouse For The Blind (CAGE: 64083), under the AbilityOne Program. This acquisition is being conducted as a noncompetitive contract action under the authority of Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Overhaul (RFO) 6.103-5(b): "Authorized or required by statute". The AbilityOne Program dictates that the Lighthouse for the Blind is considered a Mandatory Source. The justification for soliciting and negotiating with a single source is as follows: AbilityOne Program Alignment: Fulfilling this order through the Lighthouse supports the federal policy of purchasing designated supplies and services from qualified nonprofit agencies employing people who are blind or severely disabled. This notice of intent is NOT a request for competitive proposals and no solicitation document exists for the requirement. Sources interested in responding to this notice are required to submit a capability statement that includes technical data and cost information, sufficient detail and with convincing evidence that clearly demonstrates the capability to meet the requirement. Requests for documentation, additional information, or submissions that only ask questions will not be considered as an affirmative response. A determination by the Government not to compete based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement or to proceed with a single source procurement. Capability statements are due on 09/18/26 by 10:00 AM CST. Capability statements shall be submitted by email ONLY as a Microsoft Word or Adobe PDF attachment to phillip.chambers.4@us.af.mil and ryan.lafever.2@us.af.mil. Capability statements and supporting documentation provided after the due date listed above will not be reviewed. Please see attached Single Source Justification for further information.

title: Mobile Mass Notification System for ASG-Jordan
description: SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS Title: Mobile Mass Notification System for ASG-Jordan Directorate of Logistics Notice Type: Sources Sought Notice Number: ASG-J08262026AG. NAICS Code: 334290 � Other Communications Equipment Manufacturing or 561621 � Security Systems Services Response Due Date: 15 SEP 2026 NLT 1700 1.0 Introduction This is a Sources Sought Notice only. It is issued solely for information and planning purposes � it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This request for information does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Offerors are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this Sources Sought. 2.0 Background and Scope Area Support Group - Jordan requires a mobile mass notification capability for deployment. The purpose of this procurement is to acquire two (2) Mobile High-Powered Speaker Stations (MHPSS) and associated communication and control equipment. These systems will provide essential mobile mass notification capabilities for the base to ensure personnel safety and effective incident response. Scope of Work: The Contractor shall provide support to the ASG-J Jordan Directorate of Logistics by furnishing the following capabilities: Mobile High-Powered Speaker Stations (MHPSS) Trailer Units - Quantity: 2 Mobile Central Control Unit (MCCU) - Quantity: 1 200W Solar Power Packages - Quantity: 2 Conventional Radios (VHF/UHF Analog) & Cellular 4G LTE-A Routers - Quantity: 3 each Associated batteries, antennas, cables, and installation/start-up services. The Contractor shall perform in accordance with the standards and acceptable quality levels identified in the Performance Work Statement (PWS), applicable U.S. Army regulations, pamphlets, doctrine, Department of Defense manuals and instructions, and all other related contract documents. 3.0 Requested Information (Capability Statement) Communication Control (1 System): Mobile Central Control Unit (MCCU): Must feature a 7" touch screen for the user interface, an 8-watt amplifier with 1W internal speaker, connection for external speaker, (2) supervised push-button inputs, (1) 12VDC strobe output (1A max), (2) signaling relay outputs, microphone input, RJ45 Ethernet port, and line-level audio I/O. Control/Power: Internal 12V UPS, noise-canceling microphone, and capabilities for 8 hours of standby operation. Intelligent Control Gateway Board (ICG): Controller with a 32-bit ARM processor and multiple interfaces (Ethernet, USB, CANbus, RS232, RS485, radio, and telephone). Must support Ethernet/IP interface (including IPv6), advanced security, relays, and provide digital storage for prerecorded voice messages in field units. Outdoor High-Powered Speaker Stations (2 Systems): Audio Power: Each station must provide a minimum of 1600 watts of audio power. Enclosure: NEMA4X stainless steel siren enclosure with an attached ventilated battery compartment, integrated Class D amplifier, controller, intrusion switch, temperature-compensated battery charger, and power ON/OFF circuit breaker. Speaker Head: Stationary speaker head including four (4) 400W speaker horns with drivers. Siren Trailer: Must include a telescopic speaker pole, standard type bolt-on drawbar eye for vehicle transportation, front and rear expanding leveling jacks, utility cabinet, and rear/side vehicle lights. Local Operating Console (LOC): Must allow mounting up to 200 feet away from the panel. Must feature an LCD screen, noise-canceling microphone, and IP65 push-button membrane for local control, diagnostics, and live voice announcements. Power Supply: 200W Solar Package (including 200W solar panels, cables, and high-wind support brackets) and 12V, 100AH GEL batteries (4 per unit, 12 total required per air freight regulations). Prerecorded Messages: Must include digital message recording capabilities for at least 15 minutes of recording time, stored locally on the ICG boards. Radio and Cellular Communication Equipment: Radios: Conventional VHF/UHF Analog radios, up to 25W. Antennas & Accessories: OMNI Fiber Glass VHF antennas, surge protectors, and properly rated antenna cables. Cellular: 4G LTE-A Routers (NA compatible) with DIN rail mounting brackets and 3-in-1 Panel Antennas (2x5G/LTE, GNSS). 4.0 Submission Instructions Format: Submissions must be in [PDF/Word] format. Page Limit: Capability statements shall not exceed 5 pages. Delivery: Submit responses via email to the following Contracting Personnel. Yaa D. Agyepong-Wiafe Operational Contract Support (ASC) Director Area Support Group (ASG) - Jordan Joint Training Center- Jordon Email: yaa.d.agyepongwiafe.mil@army.mil Cassandra. Y Petway SFC, USA Operational Contract Support NCOIC cassandra.y.petway.mil@army.mil, and Hector G Vega, Assistant Director, Hector.g.vega.civ@army.mil Subject Line: Please use the subject line: "Sources Sought Response: ASG-Jordan Logistics Support - [Company Name]".

title: Deschutes National Forest Belly Dump Trailer Reconditioning
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1240BE26Q0108 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for complete reconditioning of two belly dump trailers. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 811310 The small business size standard is $12.5 million This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. Statement of Requirement The Government requires the complete reconditioning of two belly dump trailers. Work includes full structural refurbishment, replacement of critical mechanical systems, and complete modernization of electrical, air, and safety components. Both trailers will undergo full frame inspection and reinforcement, including crack repair, straightening, and replacement or fabrication of structural elements such as crossmembers and push blocks. The requirement includes full suspension and axle replacement, installation of a new kingpin and upper coupler components (if needed), and a complete electrical and air system overhaul from front to back. The trailers� hopper and gate systems will be rebuilt, including installation of a new AR liner, rebushed hinges, and new cylinders. Both trailers will receive new hardware throughout, updated safety equipment, a new landing gear assembly, and a new fender and mudflap system. Additionally, each trailer will be fitted with new wheels and tires. Finally, both trailers must undergo a complete sandblast, surface preparation, priming, and repainting process to restore protective coatings and ensure long?term durability. All work must return the trailers to safe, reliable, and fully operational condition suitable for continued service.

title: Public Environmental Services at Downtown BID
description: Notice of Intent to Issue a Sole Source Contract for public environmental services around the commercial and office buildings, as well as the public spaces within the Downtown BID jurisdiction in Washington DC. Description: The General Services Administration (GSA) Public Building Service (PBS) Acquisition Center for Facilities Management Services (ACFMS) - East intends to issue a sole source contract in accordance with FAR 6.103-1. The proposed contract will include a twelve-month base period and three twelve-month option periods. The contract work will be performed at the Downtown BID jurisdiction in Washington DC. The contract will provide the following services: Cleanliness, Maintenance and Beautification Supplement municipal trash collection by bagging, hauling, and compacting trash and recycling from cans and the ground around GSA buildings for collection by the Department of Public Works. Remove graffiti and other applied vandalism from buildings, sidewalks, and fixtures within 24 hours. Clean dirt, litter, and grime from sidewalks around GSA buildings, and power clean sidewalks and public spaces on a regular basis. Remove gum and gum stains from sidewalks around GSA buildings using specialized mechanical equipment. Paint and visually improve public space elements around GSA buildings, including benches, trash receptacles, poles, lights, tree boxes, newsstands, and other designated fixtures. Plant and maintain flowers, trees, tree boxes, hanging flower baskets, and other landscaping around targeted GSA buildings. Operate a targeted rat abatement program wherever needed in the BID area. Homeless Services Engage a social services agency to provide full-time professional outreach workers to connect individuals experiencing homelessness with essential services, while helping GSA and other property owners eliminate encampments and aggressive panhandling. Coordinate efforts directly with the Department of Health (detox), Department of Mental Health (homeless outreach), Department of Employment Services, and Department of Human Services (food stamps and medical assistance) to deliver resources directly to the downtown homeless population. Focus on connecting the most entrenched population�specifically the severely mentally ill and those battling addictions�with housing recovery programs. Maintain and train a select group of Downtown Safety Ambassadors (SAM) to serve on the Homeless Outreach Service Team (HOST). Expand HOST activities to work with GSA, as well as public and private property managers, to discourage encampments and aggressive panhandling in private spaces. Coordinate outreach efforts with other Business Improvement Districts (BIDs). Develop additional strategies related to the 2nd and D Street shelter to improve the quality of life for GSA and other tenants in adjacent buildings. Expand the BID's education efforts to reach office workers, residents, and visitors. Economic Development Maintain its role as a center for research and information regarding the downtown economy Continue the collection and analysis of data, as well as the production of reports to help inform business and development decisions in the downtown area. Assist in developing financing plans and exploring possibilities for large-scale projects that support downtown infrastructure. General Support to GSA The BID�s professional staff and consultants will be facilitating collaborative planning with GSA and other major downtown stakeholders, including the city and private development community. This effort will address common concerns such as security, transportation and access, environmental issues, and development. The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1) as cited in FAR 6.302-1: �Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements�. Downtown BID is formally registered as a business improvement district in the District of Columbia and is the only firm capable of partnering with property owners in the designated area to provide a comprehensive bundle of enhanced services. These services go beyond the levels provided by other governmental or private sector sources. Currently, there is no other known public or private entity with the broad support and capacity required to simultaneously make the relevant area safe, clean, and user-friendly. The current contract is scheduled to expire on October 6, 2026. GSA will consider any bids, proposals, quotations, or capability statements. Any response shall be submitted via e-mail to Jose Nativisegovia, Contracting Officer via email at jose.nativisegovia@gsa.gov NO LATER THAN Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 4:00 PM EST. The agency will consider any such submission.

The Main Entrance of Bldg. 1 will be updated to facilitate visitor traffic flow and experience. The existing revolving door will be replaced with an airlock of sliding and swinging doors with automatic controls. This project has a set of drawings and specifications that have been created by an Architectural-Engineering firm. These drawings and specifications indicate the work to be performed. Work includes, but is not limited to, general construction, alterations, mechanical and electrical work, utility systems, necessary demolition and removal of existing structures, associated appurtenances and certain other items necessary completion. All work shall be performed in accordance with solicitation/contract terms and conditions, specifications and drawings, and all applicable VA TIL and local and National codes. Contractor shall furnish all supervision, tools, labor, materials, equipment, transportation and testing necessary. Contractor will perform site investigations to fully inform themselves of the conditions and limitations applied to the work. All project work shall be installed in accordance with all applicable standards available at time of installation to include published commercial specifications as well as standards and preferences expressed in this document. title: Deschutes National Forest Belly Dump Trailer Reconditioning
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1240BE26Q0108 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for complete reconditioning of two belly dump trailers. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 811310 The small business size standard is $12.5 million This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. Statement of Requirement The Government requires the complete reconditioning of two belly dump trailers. Work includes full structural refurbishment, replacement of critical mechanical systems, and complete modernization of electrical, air, and safety components. Both trailers will undergo full frame inspection and reinforcement, including crack repair, straightening, and replacement or fabrication of structural elements such as crossmembers and push blocks. The requirement includes full suspension and axle replacement, installation of a new kingpin and upper coupler components (if needed), and a complete electrical and air system overhaul from front to back. The trailers� hopper and gate systems will be rebuilt, including installation of a new AR liner, rebushed hinges, and new cylinders. Both trailers will receive new hardware throughout, updated safety equipment, a new landing gear assembly, and a new fender and mudflap system. Additionally, each trailer will be fitted with new wheels and tires. Finally, both trailers must undergo a complete sandblast, surface preparation, priming, and repainting process to restore protective coatings and ensure long?term durability. All work must return the trailers to safe, reliable, and fully operational condition suitable for continued service.

title: Romania – Vocational training services – Servicii de formare profesională pentru consolidarea competențelor în domeniul performanței fondurilor UE - cod SMIS 318850
description: Obiectul achiziției este furnizarea unui pachet integrat de servicii de formare profesională pentru consolidarea competențelor beneficiarilor fondurilor europene și ale personalului din sistemul de management și control în domeniul indicatorilor, al cadrului de performanță și al colectării, prelucrării, analizei și utilizării datelor. Contractul cuprinde două activități complementare de formare profesională: a) program de formare profesională destinat personalului implicat în elaborarea și implementarea proiectelor finanțate din fondurile Politicii de Coeziune; b) program de perfecționare profesională destinat personalului din sistemul de management și control, în domeniul prelucrării și analizei statistice a datelor, proiectat și desfășurat prin utilizarea unui software statistic specializat. Se solicită operatorilor economici să-și păstreze valabilitatea ofertei 6 luni de la data limită de depunere a ofertelor. Durata contractului: 24 luni de la momentul semnării contractului de către ultima parte Valoarea estimata: 1.680.230,40 lei, exclusiv TVA Garanția de participare : Nu este cazul. Garanția de bună execuție: se solicită constituirea garanției de bună execuție în valoare de 10 % din valoarea contractului fără TVA. În conformitate cu prevederile art. 154 alin. (3) și alin (4) din Legea nr. 98/2016, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, având în vedere specificul serviciilor ce fac obiectul prezentei achiziții, în scopul asigurării autorității contractante privind îndeplinirea cerințelor calitative a serviciilor și în perioada convenită a contractului, se consideră necesară constituirea garanției de bună execuție a contractului de către operatorul economic semnatar al contractului. Potrivit art. 154 alin. (3) din Legea nr. 98/2016, cu modificările și completările ulterioare, se stabileste valoarea garanției de bună execuție prin raportare la complexitatea contractului într-un cuantum corespunzător unui procent de 10% din valoarea contractului, fără TVA. Perioada de valabilitate a garanţiei de bună execuție va fi egală cu durata contractului. Data limită pentru depunerea ofertei: 05.10.2026 (minim 30 zile de la data transmiterii spre publicare), ora 23:59 la adresa de e-mail lucian.mihai@mfe.gov.ro. Data limită pentru transmiterea solicitărilor de clarificări: 15.09.2026, ora 23:59. Data la care autoritatea contractantă va răspunde consolidat la solicitările de clarificări: 24.09.2026, ora 23:59. Toate informatiile privind participarea la prezenta procedura, precum si setul de documente aferente se regasesc pe site-ul MIPE ( https://mfe.gov.ro/invitatii-de-participare/ ) la sectiunea Interes Public/Achizitii publice/Invitatii de participare. description: ДСП се създава за доставка на различни видове медицински изделия и консумативи за нуждите на ,,МБАЛ -Благоевград" АД. Първоначално планиранираната "Техническа спецификация" може да бъде частично променяна в хода на провеждане на динамичната система, като се добавят нови медицински изделия и/или консумативи и/или се променят количествата им. Посочените количества в приложената към документацията „Техническа спецификация" са прогнозни и не пораждат задължение за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Фактическото изпълнение на обществената поръчка ще се определи на базата на реално доставените медицински изделия и консумативи, в рамките на финансовия ресурс. Обменът на документи и съобщения между Възложители, кандидати, участници и изпълнители на обществени поръчки се осъществява чрез Централизираната електронна платформа. Срокът на ДСП е 36 месеца . Динамичната система за покупки е отворена през целия си срок на действие за всеки кандидат, който отговаря на критериите за подбор. Достъпът и участието в нея са свободни и безплатни за всички заинтересовани лица. Срок на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените поръчки в рамките на ДСП е за период от 12 /дванадесет/ месеца. Динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) се провежда на етапи. Съгласно чл.101 от ЗОП, в зависимост от етапа на процедурата кандидатите подават заявления за участие, а квалифицираните (допуснати) кандидати - оферти. ДСП се управлява като изцяло електронен процес и през целия срок на действие на системата за покупки тя е открита за всеки стопански субект /изпълняващ орган/ИО/, който отговаря на критериите за подбор. Посочените критерии за подбор, са и критерии за изключване. Възложителят осигурява пълен, неограничен и пряк достъп до документацията по настоящата процедура чрез Централизираната електронна платформа, наричана "платформата". Заявленията и офертите трябва да се изготвят и представят в съответствие с изискванията на чл. 101 от ЗОП и чл.47 от ППЗОП, в срока посочен в обявлението. Всяко заявление и Всяка оферта се подава в системата на ЦАИС ЕОП Първи етап /първоначално събиране на заявления за участие/: Квалифициране на доставчиците ( допускане на доставчиците до системата ) . На този етап се събират заявления за участие. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържа/т информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 25.09.2026 г. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 10 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления. Заявления могат да се подават и след крайния срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, в тези случаи кандидатите ще получават покани след одобряване на включването им в ДСП. Възложителят определя с Решение за подбор квалифицираните доставчици. След влизане в сила на Решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. Втори етап /събиране на оферти по конкретни покани/: Следва изпращане на покана за представяне на оферти за конкретна обществена поръчка до тези доставчици, които са били квалифицирани/допуснати. Офертите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. Съгласно чл.39, ал.1 от ППЗОП с подаването на оферта се счита, че кандидатите се съгласяват с всички условия на възложителя, в т.ч. с определения от него срок на валидност на офертите и с проекта на договор. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления, подадени в посоченият по-горе срок. При конкретни поръчки по покани офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще е достъпна и безплатна за всички кандидати. Осигурен е неограничен, пълен и пряк достъп до документацията за обществената поръчка през целия срок на действие на ДСП. *По всяко време заинтересовани лица могат да подават заявления за допускане/включване в ДСП. Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите предложения два пъти в месеца (1- во и 15-то число на месеца ) или на две седмици веднъж. Възложителят ще издава решение за допускане на кандидатите в ДСП. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията Възложителят издава Решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се присъединяват към ДСП.

title: HVAC services at Grey Towers Historical Site, PA
description: Description - Grey Towers Historical Site HVAC services. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 12444326Q0044 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for Grey Towers Historical Site HVAC services. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 238220. The small business size standard is $19 (Size standards in millions of dollars). This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. A Q&A document will be posted to this solicitation on SAM.GOV during the solicitation period, if applicable. In order to facilitate site visit preparations, it is requested that the COR Elizabeth Hawke be contacted via email at elizabeth.hawke@usda.gov and advised of the number of persons who will attend.

title: Emergency Medical Support and Evacuation (MedEvac) Services
description: This notice constitutes Amendment No. 1 to the Solicitation/Request for Proposal (RFP) for the Emergency Medical Support and Evacuation (MedEvac) Services 80JSC026MEDEVAC5Q. All Offerors shall acknowledge this amendment in their responses. This notice serves as the official amendment to subject Solicitation/RFP and a written amendment will not be issued, and all updates are clearly marked with red strikethrough and underline within the attachments identified below. The purpose of this Amendment No. 1 is to: 1. Post submitted RFP Questions and Answers as an Attachment 2. Update Attachment RFP_Solicitation 80JSC027R0003 MedEvac_Final.pdf to update the solicitation number in document name, and on Block 5 on Page 1. Deletes the solicitation number in the footer. 3. Update Request for Information (RFI) Questions and Answers.pdf to delete the solicitation number in header. The due date for receipt of offers is not extended. Offerors shall provide the information stated in the synopsis/solicitation. ****************************************************************************************************************************************************** The Government's intention is to solicit information that will permit a competitive evaluation of the Offeror's proposal. The information solicited will demonstrate the Offeror's competence and understanding of requirements and the capability to successfully complete all the requirements specified in the MEDEVAC SOW. All responsible sources may submit an offer, which shall be considered by the Agency. The Government intends to make a single award for all items on an "all or none" basis; therefore, Offerors must provide a proposal that responds to all items. Partial quotes will not be considered responsible to this solicitation and therefore not accepted. The Government intends to award the resulting Purchase Order, if any, without discussions. Offerors are invited to submit a proposal for this project (MedEvac) following the instructions in this solicitation located in the document entitled, "RFP_Solicitation 80JSC027R0003 MedEvac," which is attached to this solicitation. This solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-01. The NAICS Code and the small business size standard for this procurement are 621910 and revenue of $22.5 million, respectively. The Offeror shall state in their offer their size status for this procurement. All responsible sources may submit an offer, which shall be considered by the agency. NASA is not requesting any political security advisory or evacuation services. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS This notice is being issued as a solicitation, specifically a Request for Proposal (RFP), for MEDEVAC 5. The minimum requirements for the resulting contract in Section C - Statement of Work.

title: Acoustic Attenuators Part Number (P/N) 6509861-1; National Stock Number (NSN) 4920-01-216-8033)
description: The Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division (NAWCAD) announces the release of Request for Quote (RFQ) N68335-26-Q-1166 for the competitive procurement of a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract. This requirement is for eight (8) Acoustic Attenuators (P/N: 6509861-1, NSN: 4920-01-216-8033) in support of the H-60 Helicopter Program. This solicitation is being issued as a 100% Small Business Set-Aside in accordance with FAR Part 19. Full details, instructions to offerors, and evaluation criteria are provided in the attached solicitation. Technical Data Package and Export Control Requirements This solicitation includes DFARS 252.204-7025, Notice of Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) Requirements. The technical data package contains Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). Offerors must obtain access to the CUI drawing package to prepare a proposal. Proof of CMMC Level 2 (Self) Assessment certification is required to request access to the technical data package. Refer to Section A of the solicitation document for full instructions regarding CMMC. The Government owns the Build-to-Print Technical Drawing Package, which is considered Export Controlled. All Offerors must possess a current and certified DD Form 2345 (Militarily Critical Technical Data Agreement) to request access to the drawings. Drawings will be provided to the designated data custodian listed on the certified DD Form 2345 via the DoD SAFE website. Refer to Section A of the solicitation document for full instructions regarding DD Form 2345. Requesting Access to Solicitation Documents: To request access to the Government-provided documents associated with this solicitation, Offerors must submit the following via email: Proof of current and valid CMMC Level 2 (self-assessment) certification; and A certified DD Form 2345. Requests should be sent to the Point of Contact (POC) listed below: Solicitation Number: N68335-26-Q-1166 Point of Contact and Questions The Point of Contact (POC) for this solicitation is Suresh Jafar, at suresh.jafar.civ@us.navy.mil. All questions and inquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted via email and reference Solicitation Number: N68335-26-Q-1166 (Acoustic Attenuators) in the subject line. Offerors are encouraged to review the solicitation and attachments thoroughly before submitting questions or requests for access. This RFQ shall not be construed as obligating the Government to award a contract, nor does it authorize work to commence or serve as a basis for any future claims against the Government.

title: V-22 Flight Director Panel
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), V-22 Joint Program Office (PMA-275) intends to negotiate and award a Delivery Order under a Basic Ordering Agreement (BOA) N00019-23-G-0004 to Honeywell International, 1944 E. Sky Harbor Circle Phoenix, AZ 85034 on a sole-source basis for: The Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) and support required to complete design analysis, conduct the development technical reviews, perform product testing, validation, and verification, and associated product/development documentation for the V-22 Flight Director Panel (FDP). This action is being awarded on a sole source basis to Honeywell in accordance with the statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition under Title 10 U.S.C 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR Part 6.103-1, �Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements.� Honeywell is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the FDP. The Government does not possess (or cannot provide) the data necessary to perform the required repairs of the items. Consequently, Honeywell is the only responsible source with the necessary access to the technical data and requisite expertise to perform the contemplated effort within the required schedule. The proposed contract action is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under authority of FAR 6.103. Interested persons may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. However, any capability statements received within fifteen days after date of publication of this notice will be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement.

description: Israel Job Order Contract (JOC) Scope of Work: The USACE Middle East District is assessing industry capability to perform construction-related services for Sustainment, Restoration, and Modernization (SRM), simplified acquisition of base repair requirements, real property maintenance, and small-scale renovation efforts at various sites throughout Israel. title: GAOA LDV Crystal Lakes Water & Septic Resuscitation, PSICC, Colorado
description: On September 1, 2026, amendment 0001 to solicitation 1240LT26Q0107 - GAOA LDV Crystal Lakes Water & Septic Resuscitation at Pikes National Forest has been posted to SAM.gov and accomplished the following: 1. Post RFI questions and answers labeled C05a RFI QA 1240LT26Q0107. 2. Post pre-bid sign in sheet labeled C05b Site Visit 2026.08.19. This SF30 must be acknowledged and submitted with your proposal. ****************************************************************************************************************************************************** This project involves installing a new 2-inch HDPE waterline beneath Colorado Highway 24, including completing all Subsurface Utility Engineering required for CDOT permitting. Work includes connecting the new waterline from Dwelling 1 to the existing distribution system, replacing the well pump to provide a 15 GPM supply, installing a dual?stage booster pump and basement water storage, and performing associated electrical upgrades such as relocating meters, burying service lines, upgrading panels, and supporting septic and booster pump systems. The project also replaces multiple septic systems serving the Blue House, Brown House, Bunkhouse, and Shop, installs new sewer and dosing infrastructure, and includes asphalt removal along with new road and gate installation.

title: Emergency Medical Support and Evacuation (MedEvac) Services
description: The Government's intention is to solicit information that will permit a competitive evaluation of the Offeror's proposal. The information solicited will demonstrate the Offeror's competence and understanding of requirements and the capability to successfully complete all the requirements specified in the MEDEVAC SOW. All responsible sources may submit an offer, which shall be considered by the Agency. The Government intends to make a single award for all items on an "all or none" basis; therefore, Offerors must provide a proposal that responds to all items. Partial quotes will not be considered responsible to this solicitation and therefore not accepted. The Government intends to award the resulting Purchase Order, if any, without discussions. Offerors are invited to submit a proposal for this project (MedEvac) following the instructions in this solicitation located in the document entitled, "RFP_Solicitation 80JSC027R0003 MedEvac," which is attached to this solicitation. This solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-01. The NAICS Code and the small business size standard for this procurement are 621910 and revenue of $22.5 million, respectively. The Offeror shall state in their offer their size status for this procurement. All responsible sources may submit an offer, which shall be considered by the agency. NASA is not requesting any political security advisory or evacuation services. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS This notice is being issued as a solicitation, specifically a Request for Proposal (RFP), for MEDEVAC 5. The minimum requirements for the resulting contract in Section C - Statement of Work.

title: Shatter Resistant Window Film Notice
description: SUBJECT Reminder: Due Date of December 31, 2016, for Window Film Manufacturers to Comply with SD-STD-03.01 Revision A Performance Requirements or be Removed from the DS-Approved List of SRWF Products for Department of State Applications The Department of State has developed a new standard, SD-STD-01.03 Revision A, Performance Standard for Window Film for Department of State Applications. The Bureau of Diplomatic Security (DS) maintains the DS-Approved List of SRWF Products for Department of State Applications. Only SRWF products included on this list are authorized for installation in Department facilities. New SRWF products that meet the following performance requirements are eligible to be added to that list: Performance standards per SD-STD-03.01 Revision A Meet class A or Class I under ASTM E 84 flame test. Surface Abrasion, in haze not to exceed 3.2 percent following 100 turns, using 500-gram weights on a CS10F abrasive wheel when tested in accordance with ASTM D 1044 Products already on the DS-Approved List of SRWF Products for Department of State Applications will be required to pass the testing requirements outlined above by on December 31th, 2026 to remain on the list. New film products are required to pass these testing requirements to be put on the DS-Approved List. The SD-STD-03.01 Revision A is currently a Department of State standard; however, we are actively coordinating with ASTM International to have this be developed into an official ASTM standard. Questions regarding this notification or implementation of SD-STD-01.03 Revision A should be directed to PSD/RD staff at DSPSPRD@STATE.GOV.

title: 66--Notice of Intent to Sole Source ImaCore 3D Imager
description: In accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 12 - Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services, the Department of Energy (DOE), National Energy Technology Laboratory (NETL) intends to negotiate and award a purchase order on a sole source basis to Green Imaging Technologies Inc. NETL requires this 3D Rock Core Imager as it will allow NETL to significantly enhance and improve its subsurface research capabilities. This instrument provides cutting-edge solutions to better evaluate petrophysical features and multi-phase fluid flow of geologic cores and wellbore cement. This system is patent-protected and proprietary to Green Imaging Technologies Inc. and is specifically engineered to operate seamlessly with NETL�s existing Oxford GeoSpec NMR P10 Overburden Cell. This compatible technology is required to maintain experimental continuity, prevent data corruption from system discrepancies, and ensure direct quantitative comparisons with NETL�s historical and ongoing rock core datasets. This is considered a sole source to Green Imaging Technologies Inc. because to the best of NETL�s knowledge, Green Imaging Technologies Inc. is the only known source that can provide the required instrument. No known potential alternate sources exist which could satisfy this requirement. This notice of intent is not a request or quote/proposal. title: Household Goods Moving, Shipping, Transportation, and Storage Service Providers Software Integration Request for Information
description: INTRODUCTION The Personal Property Activity (PPA) is conducting market research to understand how integrating vendor systems with a government central platform via an Application Programming Interface (API) will affect household goods (HHG) moving, shipping, transportation, and storage service providers. Accordingly, the PPA invites industry partners and service providers to submit detailed information regarding integration costs, associated software development timelines, standard industry practices, and recommendations for testing and risk mitigation when connecting their internal software systems to a central Government platform. This Request for Information (RFI) enables industry stakeholders to provide direct feedback on how this type of integration will impact their current systems and operations, helping to shape future technical requirements and acquisition decisions. This RFI is issued solely for informational and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation for proposals. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot form a binding contract. The PPA is not under any obligation to pursue any acquisition alternative based on this RFI, and the Government will not compensate respondents for any information received. All submissions will be kept confidential, will become the property of the U.S. Government, and will not be returned. SUBMISSION DEADLINE Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 4:00 PM CDT POINTS OF CONTACT (POCs) The preferred method of communication with the POCs is email. RFI submissions and questions must be submitted via email to all points of contact. title: Household Goods Moving, Shipping, Transportation, and Storage Service Providers Software Integration Request for Information
description: INTRODUCTION The Personal Property Activity (PPA) is conducting market research to understand how integrating vendor systems with a government central platform via an Application Programming Interface (API) will affect household goods (HHG) moving, shipping, transportation, and storage service providers. Accordingly, the PPA invites industry partners and service providers to submit detailed information regarding integration costs, associated software development timelines, standard industry practices, and recommendations for testing and risk mitigation when connecting their internal software systems to a central Government platform. This Request for Information (RFI) enables industry stakeholders to provide direct feedback on how this type of integration will impact their current systems and operations, helping to shape future technical requirements and acquisition decisions. This RFI is issued solely for informational and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation for proposals. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot form a binding contract. The PPA is not under any obligation to pursue any acquisition alternative based on this RFI, and the Government will not compensate respondents for any information received. All submissions will be kept confidential, will become the property of the U.S. Government, and will not be returned. SUBMISSION DEADLINE Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 4:00 PM CDT POINTS OF CONTACT (POCs) The preferred method of communication with the POCs is email. RFI submissions and questions must be submitted via email to all points of contact. Contracting Officer: Chris Frost; christopher.t.frost4.civ@mail.mil Contracts Specialist: Kevin Peaslee: kevin.p.peaslee.mil@mail.mil Technical Lead: Kipp Reed; kipp.t.reed.civ@mail.mil IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS Interested parties are advised to read the attached RFI in its entirety.

description: SOURCES SOUGHT SYNOPSIS Title: Logistics and Administrative Support Services for ASG-Jordan Directorate of Logistics Notice Type: Sources Sought NAICS Code: 541990 - All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services or 561110 - Office Administrative Services Response Due Date: 15 SEP 2026 NLT 1700 1.0 Introduction This is a Sources Sought Notice only. (UEI: TADAL13NTM57) under FAR Part 12 procedures. The requirement is for the Cobalt?60 reload of the Foss Therapy Model 484F?C irradiator, as detailed in the statement of work. This notice does not constitute a competitive solicitation. Foss Therapy Services, Inc. retains proprietary rights to the designs, engineering tolerances, and mechanical specifications of the Model 484F?C irradiator. Nevertheless, all responsible sources may submit a quotation or capability statement for consideration. Any entity that believes it can fulfill this requirement is encouraged to provide a capability statement for the Government�s review. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based on responses to this notice is solely within the Government�s discretion. Information received will be used exclusively to assess whether a competitive procurement should be conducted. The Government will not reimburse any costs incurred in responding to this notice. All responses and inquiries shall be submitted via email to Latisha Hollman at Latisha.A.Hollman@usda.gov.

The Naval Air Systems Command, H-53 Heavy Lift Helicopters Program (PMA 261), intends to issue a full and open solicitation for a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract for the Electrical Optical (EO) / Infrared (IR) Sensor System for the CH-53K program. The contract will include non-recurring engineering, engineering support, program support, production (forward fit, retrofit, spare sensor systems and adapter plates (if necessary)), testing, logistics, data, and production reach back support. This effort has an estimated performance period of approximately seven (7) years. The place of contract performance is expected to be at the contractor�s facility. The solicitation, including all attachments, is posted in the Solicitation Module of the U.S. Government PIEE website with restricted access and will only be made available to companies with a certified DD Form 2345 and verified via SAM.gov. Companies that had requested and been granted access to the DRAFT Request for Proposal under Notice EOIR_Sensor_System_Competition, posted 21 November 2025, have already been provided access in PIEE to the formal Request for Proposal (RFP) under Notice N0001927R1000. The Government may also provide separately, via the dissemination method described below, technical documents to assist Offerors with developing their proposals. title: V-22 Interface Units NRE
description: The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR), V-22 Joint Program Office (PMA-275) intends to negotiate and award a Delivery Order under a Basic Ordering Agreement (BOA) to GE Aviation Systems Limited, Cheltenham Road Bishops Cleeve, Cheltenham, GL52 8SF, United Kingdom on a sole source basis for: The Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) for the redesign of the V-22 Nacelle Interface Units (NIU), Wing Interface Units (WIU) and Avionics Bay Interface Units (ABIU), as well as the procurement and installation of redesigned kits, and the sustainment of legacy Interface Units (IUs) Weapon Replaceable Assemblies (WRAs) on V-22 aircraft. This action is being awarded on a sole source basis to GE Aviation Systems Limited in accordance with the statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition under Title 10 U.S.C 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR Part 6.103-1, �Only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements.� GE Aviation is the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the NIU, WIU, and ABIU. The Government does not possess (or cannot provide) the data necessary to perform the required repairs of the items. Consequently, GE Aviation is the only responsible source with the necessary access to the technical data and requisite expertise to perform the contemplated effort within the required schedule. The proposed contract action is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under authority of FAR 6.103. Interested persons may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. However, any capability statements received within fifteen days after date of publication of this notice will be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement.
